title: Here is New York
edition_assessment: Listing states First Scalo Edition, 2002, hardcover, original slipcase. This appears to be the Parr/Badger title and the true first Scalo edition, but the exact printing and current UK shipping must be reconfirmed before purchase.
condition: Near Fine; seller states not ex-library and original slipcase present.
comparable_evidence: Other current first-edition dealer copies found at about US$110 to US$125; recent Catawiki first-edition results were about EUR40 and EUR79. AbeBooks also shows ordinary used copies around US$30, but the Greenwood copy is explicitly Near Fine, first Scalo edition, with slipcase.
estimated_fair_range: Approximately US$60 to US$110 before UK shipping for a clean first Scalo edition in slipcase; higher dealer asks exist.
discount_estimate: Roughly 55% to 85% below stronger current dealer asks before shipping, depending on the final delivered price.
confidence: Medium-high on edition identification; medium on current availability because search indexing can lag.
verdict: STRONG BUY if still available and UK shipping is sensible

title: Dienststelle Marienthal
edition_assessment: Seller describes the 2000 first edition of Dienststelle Marienthal with the folded facility plan. This is the Parr/Badger title. It is the standard first edition, not the special edition of 75 with print and objects.
condition: Interior described as well preserved; dust jacket slightly light-faded with small lesions; folded plan present.
comparable_evidence: A current ZVAB dealer copy of the standard 2000 first edition with plan was EUR260 plus shipping. Special edition examples with signed print and objects are around US$1,200 and are not comparable to this standard copy.
estimated_fair_range: Approximately EUR240 to EUR320 for a complete standard first edition in comparable condition.
discount_estimate: About 20% to 35% below a current comparable dealer ask before shipping.
confidence: High on edition identification; medium-high on value.
